about: Reviewed, explicit links from products-liability MDLs (titles exactly as in corpus dataset mdls, JPML report dated 2026-10-01) to exposure-geography sources. Part D rows match only the exact CMS Gnrc_Name / Brnd_Name strings listed here; nothing is matched by similarity. A class named in a title is resolved only through the NLM RxClass FDA Established Pharmacologic Class membership cited. PLACES measures link to an MDL only when the title names the injury or an FDA label states the indication of the drug the title names. Reviewed 2026-10-27 by the de-exposure workstream; entries marked include=false or basis=candidate_unreviewed are not shown in the app.
title_source: Corpus dataset mdls (JPML pending MDL report dated 2026-10-01)
